result.topic_en: Cubic residues and non-residues modulo a prime 6q+1: the split of the non-residues into two orders, the consequence that every such prime divides a number of the form aa+3bb, and a worked table of cubic residues and non-residues modulo 373.
result.transcription:
50 L. EULERI OPERA POSTHUMA. Arithmetica.

$B^2$, $B^2\alpha$, $B^2\beta$, $B^2\gamma$, etc. utrobique totidem numero, quot dantur residua, et omnes hi numeri a praecedentibus erunt diversi. Praeterea vero vel $AB$, vel $AB^2$ non erit residuum; altero certe existente residuo, altero non-residuo. (*)

401. Si $AB$ non est residuum, binos ordines non-residuorum ita repraesentare poterimus:
Ordo prior: $A$, $A\alpha$, $A\beta$, $A\gamma$, etc. $B$, $B\alpha$, $B\beta$, $B\gamma$, etc.
Ordo posterior: $A^2$, $A^2\alpha$, $A^2\beta$, $A^2\gamma$, etc. $B^2$, $B^2\alpha$, $B^2\beta$, $B^2\gamma$, etc.
et quivis numerus ordinis prioris $A$, per quemlibet posterioris multiplicatus, praebet residuum, et quidem per quemlibet diversum; unde plura residua prodirent, quam revera sunt, quod esset absurdum.

402. Cum ergo ex divisore primo $6q+1$ tantum $2q$ residua existant, dato quovis cubo $a^3$, dabitur alius $b^3$, minor quam $(6q+1)^3$, quorum differentia per $6q+1$ erit divisibilis, ideoque $aa+ab+bb$ per eum quoque erit divisibilis. Omnis ergo numerus primus $6q+1$ est divisor talis numeri $aa+3bb$, vel talis $aa+3$, vel $3aa+1$.

404. Cum igitur divisore primo existente $6q+1$, multitudo non-residuorum duplo major sit quam multitudo residuorum, etiam pauciores erunt divisores, pro quibus datus numerus inter residua contineatur. Ita datus numerus $a$ erit residuum, si divisor fuerit factor talis formae $x^3 \pm ay^3$, vel etiam talis $x^3 \pm aay^3$; si enim sit $x^3 \pm ay^3 = dn$, cubus $x^3$ per $d$ divisus residuum dat $ay^3$, sicque etiam $a$ erit in residuis.

(*) Script. ad marg. Demonstrari debet, ambo simul non esse posse non-residua. Si $AB$ est non-residuum, vel in ordine $A$, vel $B$, vel $A^2$, vel $B^2$ continetur. At singula sunt absurda, ergo esset $AB$ residuum.

methods.what: For non-residues A, B in different classes, exactly one of AB and AB^2 is a cubic residue
methods.quote: Praeterea vero vel $AB$, vel $AB^2$ non erit residuum; altero certe existente residuo, altero non-residuo.

methods.what: Partition of the cubic non-residues into two cosets (orders), each the size of the residue set, with the argument by counting that a product of a first-order and a second-order element is a residue
methods.quote:
Ordo prior: $A$, $A\alpha$, $A\beta$, $A\gamma$, etc. $B$, $B\alpha$, $B\beta$, $B\gamma$, etc.
Ordo posterior: $A^2$, $A^2\alpha$, $A^2\beta$, $A^2\gamma$, etc. $B^2$, $B^2\alpha$, $B^2\beta$, $B^2\gamma$, etc.

methods.what: Modulo a prime 6q+1 there are only 2q cubic residues, so two distinct cubes are congruent, hence p divides aa+ab+bb
methods.quote: Cum ergo ex divisore primo $6q+1$ tantum $2q$ residua existant, dato quovis cubo $a^3$, dabitur alius $b^3$, minor quam $(6q+1)^3$, quorum differentia per $6q+1$ erit divisibilis, ideoque $aa+ab+bb$ per eum quoque erit divisibilis.

methods.what: Every prime 6q+1 divides a number of the form aa+3bb (or aa+3, or 3aa+1)
methods.quote: Omnis ergo numerus primus $6q+1$ est divisor talis numeri $aa+3bb$, vel talis $aa+3$, vel $3aa+1$.

methods.what: Table of cubic residues and of the two orders of non-residues modulo 373 (listed up to 186, with ±), each class having 124 elements
methods.quote: Speciminis loco sit divisor 373, et tam residua cuborum, quam non-residua utriusque ordinis ita se habebunt:

methods.what: Criterion: a is a cubic residue modulo d if d divides x^3 ± a y^3 or x^3 ± a^2 y^3
methods.quote: Ita datus numerus $a$ erit residuum, si divisor fuerit factor talis formae $x^3 \pm ay^3$, vel etiam talis $x^3 \pm aay^3$; si enim sit $x^3 \pm ay^3 = dn$, cubus $x^3$ per $d$ divisus residuum dat $ay^3$, sicque etiam $a$ erit in residuis.

items.quote: Praeterea vero vel $AB$, vel $AB^2$ non erit residuum; altero certe existente residuo, altero non-residuo.
items.english: Moreover either AB or AB^2 will not be a residue; one of them certainly being a residue, the other a non-residue.

items.quote: Demonstrari debet, ambo simul non esse posse non-residua.
items.english: It must be demonstrated that both cannot simultaneously be non-residues.

items.quote: Si $AB$ est non-residuum, vel in ordine $A$, vel $B$, vel $A^2$, vel $B^2$ continetur. At singula sunt absurda, ergo esset $AB$ residuum.
items.english: If AB is a non-residue, it is contained either in the order A, or B, or A^2, or B^2. But each of these is absurd, therefore AB would be a residue.

items.quote: Omnis ergo numerus primus $6q+1$ est divisor talis numeri $aa+3bb$, vel talis $aa+3$, vel $3aa+1$.
items.english: Therefore every prime number 6q+1 is a divisor of such a number aa+3bb, or of such aa+3, or 3aa+1.

items.quote: Cum igitur divisore primo existente $6q+1$, multitudo non-residuorum duplo major sit quam multitudo residuorum, etiam pauciores erunt divisores, pro quibus datus numerus inter residua contineatur.
items.english: Since therefore, when the divisor is a prime 6q+1, the number of non-residues is twice as large as the number of residues, there will also be fewer divisors for which a given number is contained among the residues.
